lines.h1: Tiimo or Todoist? Here's the answer in ten seconds.
lines.h2: Forget things all the time? Todoist. It catches every task you type or say.
lines.h3: Lose track of time? Tiimo. It shows your day and counts each task down.
lines.h4: Now, five rounds to prove it. Plus one bonus round, where a third app comes in.
lines.r1a: Round one. Getting tasks out of your head.
lines.r1b: Todoist's Ramble lets you just talk, and it turns what you say into tasks with dates and projects.
lines.r1c: Tiimo's AI turns a brain dump into timed tasks, but it's slower than a one-line capture.
lines.r1d: For catching everything, round to Todoist.
lines.r2b: Tiimo lays your day out as colored blocks, morning, day and evening, with the next thing always in front of you.
lines.r2c: Todoist opens on a list of what's due. It has a calendar layout, but the home screen is still a list.
lines.r2d: For time blindness, round to Tiimo.
lines.r3b: Tiimo has a visual focus timer that counts the task down, right on your lock screen.
lines.r3c: Todoist has reminders and due dates, but no focus timer at all.
lines.r4b: Todoist handles projects with sections, labels, filters, and shared lists you can assign.
lines.r4c: Tiimo is built around your day, not around a home renovation or a work launch.
lines.r5b: Todoist connects to Google Calendar or Outlook.
lines.r5c: Tiimo connects to Apple Calendar and Apple Reminders.
lines.r5d: If your calendar lives in Google or Outlook, round to Todoist.
lines.sc: Three rounds to two for Todoist. But if time is your problem, Tiimo wins the rounds that matter.
lines.b1: One more round. The moment you freeze on a task you've been avoiding.
lines.b2: Both can break work down with AI. But both start from organizing, your tasks in Todoist, your day in Tiimo.
lines.f1: Full disclosure, that's the gap we built FOCO for. It starts from the task you're putting off.
lines.f2: It breaks the task into tiny steps, each with a time estimate.
lines.f3: Then step one opens into a focus session, with a timer and a companion working next to you.
lines.o1: So. Todoist when you keep forgetting things. Tiimo when you keep losing track of time.
lines.o2: And FOCO when the plan is fine, but you still can't begin. Tell me in the comments which one you are.
